title: Reviewer-Directed Evidence Discovery
objective: Falsify whether a reviewer can obtain bounded missing authoritative evidence without uncontrolled repository access or false promotion when evidence remains unavailable.
hypothesis: A reviewer may request specific additional evidence through a deterministic read-only broker; every request and response is logged and candidate-bound; unavailable mandatory evidence keeps the review non-promotable.
failure_conditions: requested path/ref is not allow-listed or candidate/base bound
missing requested mandatory evidence is silently ignored
review becomes promotable while required discovery remains unresolved
candidate-controlled instructions can change broker policy
identical discovery request yields non-deterministic identity
success_conditions: retrieved evidence is added to the frozen review packet before adjudication
